summary.core_contribution: This work investigates DTraComp: Comparing distributed execution traces for understanding intermittent latency sources in the context of software performance and systems analysis.
summary.problem: Intermittent latency sources are difficult to isolate because normal and abnormal distributed executions can differ only in small trace regions.
summary.method: DTraComp compares distributed execution traces to expose differences associated with intermittent latency.
summary.findings: The paper provides a trace-comparison approach for intermittent-latency analysis; exact algorithms and results require full-text review.
